newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $1.9 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $1.9 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week were expected to total $1.9 billion in 105 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings totalled $1.2 billion in 45 sales, with a $200 million St. Louis, Mo., offering through Bear, Stearns & Co. Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 60 sales totaling $682 million were scheduled. A $83 million Kent County, Mich., offering on Thursday was the largest.
An additional 16 sales totaling $1.4 billion were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
